signals.summary: Vercel acquired Stakpak, an autonomous DevOps agent startup founded in Egypt, in July 2026. It was Vercel's third acquisition in about a year. Vercel also reportedly acquired Better Auth, an open-source auth library, within a week or so of Stakpak.
Vercel reportedly acquired Better Auth, an open-source authentication library, shortly after Stakpak. The source is a secondary news article and gives no exact date.

At Vercel Ship 2026 the company announced Vercel Services (microservices as first-class, available July 1), AI SDK 7 (over 16M weekly downloads), and Vercel Connect, which gives agents scoped temporary credentials.

Vercel Shop, its open-source Next.js storefront template for Shopify, became generally available, along with the rebuilt Hydrogen SDK for use across JS frameworks, as part of an agent-commerce push with Shopify.
A new model called Jev, introduced Sept 15, became the fastest-adopted model in AI Gateway history. Nearly 13% of paid teams used it within 24 hours.

Vercel ran a $1M bug bounty to escape Vercel Sandbox (Aug 18 to Sep 1). It received 1,285 reports and paid out $242K. One Linux kernel zero-day was found, and Vercel reports no customer data was compromised. Findings were published Oct 14.

Vercel said it crossed a $500M annualized revenue run rate in early July 2026. This comes from a third-party blog, not from Vercel directly. Separately, CEO Guillermo Rauch says AI agents account for 60% of Vercel deployments, up from 3% at the start of 2026.

Vercel is hiring for strategic cloud and product partnerships leads and for enterprise and account executives in Austin ($280K-$320K for enterprise AEs). This points to an enterprise sales and partnership build-out.
Vercel and Shopify are collaborating on agent commerce. Vercel also hosted a hackathon with OpenAI/Codex at Ship week in New York.

answer.notes: The latest funding round I found is the Series F on 2025-09-30: $300M at a $9.3B valuation, led by Accel and GIC. That is outside the 90-day window, so I did not list it as a signal. I found no new round in 2026, no layoffs and no leadership changes. Many sources show no date, and several of the signals above come from third-party aggregators (Tracxn, Okara, Launch Base Africa), so verify them before quoting them. The ~$500M run-rate figure is not confirmed by a primary source. The product launches (Ship 2026, Vercel Shop) are undated in the snippets, so they may fall slightly outside the 90 days. Possible openers: the agent-native infrastructure push, Sandbox security, enterprise expansion, and the acquisitions of Stakpak and Better Auth.
